name: p3d_koa_3
prompt: Image 1 is the full UI of a photoreal pedal steel guitar audio plugin, showing a real 10-string pedal steel guitar. Keep ALL hardware the same brushed and polished aluminium/chrome as image 1 (no brass, no gold, no engraving). A thin dark wood binding along the edges. No logos, brand names or text on the instrument. It must be indistinguishable from a real photograph.
